description: SLEIC Io Moon -- every DMD walk in the corpus, with what each one needs.
notes: Most Io Moon walks coin up inside the key script (six presses = one credit at country 4), so 'fresh' is the default and reproduces the committed corpus; a second run does NOT, because the store then carries credits and high scores that change the walk. 'multiball' is the exception -- its script has no coin presses and its README requires a store that already holds credits.
nvram: 'seed' runs the walk twice against the same store and keeps the second,
which is what gets past a firmware default-seeding boot; 'fresh' wipes first and
runs once; 'shared' reuses whatever is there.
cfg is a saved MAME cfg copied to <cfgdir>/<set>.cfg before the run -- the only
way to set a DIP in this build, since it has no command-line DIP option.
probe: the walk needs a binary built with -DDEBUG_SLEIC; the runner refuses it

walks.name: full-run
walks.desc: the whole game in one pass: general play, ORBITS, Multiball with both jackpots, the drop bank and Special Drop Probe, Wonderful Thing (the Black Hole branch), the Monolith, and the service menu

walks.name: full-run-es
walks.desc: the same walk at country 5 -- the whole game in Spanish. Needs nvram 'seed': the DIP is applied at boot (D664D) but the store must be written once before the text turns over
